@graph.name: Query Clusters
@graph.description: The demand side: 69437 query clusters grouping all 518219 intent-rubric rows by service, intent class, geo scope and target URL. Each cluster carries its canonical query (the shortest variant, the cluster’s representative phrasing), every variant phrasing, the rubric row ids it groups, and a money weight: the sampled money clusters carry the owner’s priority classes from the research dossier (P1 B2B and freight money plus the defended gun-safe #1, P2 the Winchester head terms, P3 the Martinsburg defense and category hubs); generated clusters carry "standard", meaning not separately owner-ordered. Cluster derivation is mechanical — no cluster is hand-written, and an observation-defined cluster whose text matches no rubric row carries an empty rubricRowRefs list rather than invented refs.
